import subprocess, sys, json
def run_lines(lines_bytes):
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","/app/submission/main.py"],input=lines_bytes,
                     stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=60)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout.splitlines(), p.stderr

cases = []
def add(bs): cases.append(bs)

# E_JSON cases
add(b'not json')
add(b'{')
add(b'   ')           # whitespace only
add(b'')              # empty line
add(b'{"op":"replay","op":"replay"}')  # dup key
add(b'{"op":"audit","inputs":[[[1]]],"states":[],"edges":[],"start":0,"fairness":[],"x":NaN}')
add(b'\xff\xfe')      # invalid utf8
# E_SCHEMA
add(b'{"op":"replay","inputs":[[[1]]],"slots":1,"window":1}')  # missing events
add(b'{"op":"replay","inputs":[[[1]]],"slots":1,"window":1,"events":[],"x":1}') # extra
add(b'{"op":"replay","inputs":[[[true]]],"slots":1,"window":1,"events":[]}')  # bool int
add(b'{"op":"replay","inputs":[[[1],[2]]],"slots":1,"window":1,"events":[]}') # nonrect
# E_LIMIT
add(b'{"op":"replay","inputs":[[[1000000001]]],"slots":1,"window":1,"events":[]}') # int range
add(b'{"op":"replay","inputs":[[[1]]],"slots":0,"window":1,"events":[]}') # slots range
add(b'{"op":"replay","inputs":[[[1]]],"slots":1,"window":2,"events":[]}') # window>slots

data=b'\n'.join(cases)
rc,out,err=run_lines(data)
print("rc",rc,"n",len(out))
for c,o in zip(cases,out):
    print(repr(c[:50]),"->",o.decode())
print("STDERR",err.decode()[:200])
PYEOF
